title: NATL project config
description: Schema for natl.config.yaml / natl.config.yml and env overlays under config/<env>.yaml

engine.description: Default engine when the test omits engine. Default UI: playwright.

base_url.description: Injected as vars.base_url when the test does not define it

browser.description: Adapter-specific browser id (opaque to core). Playwright: chromium | firefox | webkit.

viewport.description: Optional viewport hint passed to the adapter factory

locator_strategy.description: Default locator strategy for string elements / inline selectors (web: css | xpath; default css)

artifacts_dir.description: Failure screenshot / trace / video directory relative to the scenario

workers.description: Max concurrent scenario files for natl run (default 1). CLI --workers overrides. Not YAML parallel: steps.

trace.description: Playwright trace policy (default on-fail). CLI --trace overrides.

video.description: Playwright video policy (default off). CLI --video overrides.

soft_assert_screenshot.description: Take a screenshot on each soft assert failure (default false). CLI --soft-assert-screenshot overrides.
